name: Nikugoku no Hemi Onna-tachi o Nomikonda Inchuugoku no Buzama na Saigo ni Tsuite
original_name: 肉獄のヘミ　女たちを飲み込んだ淫蟲獄の無様な最後について
source:
Revianna and Lania, interstellar bounty hunters, were young girls dispatched to a multi-sun planet to investigate a mystery. Another member lost contact with them and went to the planet on her own. There, she found Revianna who one can hardly recognize...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ075058.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
星际赏金猎人莱比安娜与拉妮娅是两名年轻少女，受命前往一颗拥有多个太阳的行星调查谜团。另一名同伴与她们失去联系后，独自前往该行星。她在那里找到了莱比安娜，可如今的莱比安娜几乎已经令人认不出来……
